records.name: Care feed apple pictogram
records.count_unit: Named semantic care art role; repeated instances/locations not separately counted

source.hash_mode: Exact LF Git file/function through next function boundary

records.target_specific_observation: Red/magenta glossy apple with small leaf; repeated footer and requested need uses are one role.

same_scene_references.role: Exact current source for native menu/care controls, rendering grammar, original synthetic save lifecycle or painted same-scene Baby Eagle

comparison.contour: Apple, Z marks, bubble circles, heart and tennis pictograms use small generic emoji silhouettes; Baby Eagle has varied dark painted feather/wing contours. Gold stars and heart counter repeat generic stamped silhouettes.
comparison.material: Glossy plastic/gel gradients and beveled emoji stars sit beside matte broad feather bands. Bubbles are iridescent rimmed emoji orbs. These are observed glyph-style candidates; not proof every colored glyph is flat vector.
comparison.palette: Red/pink action and progress accents, cyan sleep marks and gold stars compete with pink/mint Eagle; their saturated gloss differs from the pastel same-scene painted neighbor. No global source-color average used.
comparison.light: Emoji highlights have independent shiny highlights; Eagle has authored feather/beak shading. No shared lighting/material acceptance established.
comparison.perspective: Flat UI symbol projections are legible in slots; the tennis symbol renders a racket/ball at an angled pictorial view. It is not a physically held prop or required world contact.
comparison.scale: Actual source buttons126x132 at both widths; icon art is much smaller than the touch surface. The footer duplicates all five symbols at smaller size; it is not five additional roles.
comparison.contact: Action/status symbols are UI marks and require no floor contact. Baby Eagle remains a preview card; no new character/world contact or motion is accepted.
comparison.occlusion: At1280 the fixed global Back covers the title heart;1600 leaves that heart visible. Status/action rows remain inspectable in these checkpoints. Shared shell/ornament pieces already counted separately.
comparison.readability: Repeated need/action pictogram plus mint requested tile provides a visual match. Z marks and text-heavy need/safety captions still need nonreader/child and target-device review; parser/input pass does not prove comprehension.
comparison.action_state: Neutral3hearts/1empty and1star becomes4empty/2stars after one actual requested care. Four unasked actions and repeat add0. Desired short acknowledgement/pulse does not reach live nested need label. Original Back/reopen/newMain retains carepoint4; postbattle queued/bruised/duringcare branches not reviewed.
